question: How has the triad of powers in the Lord been revealed by the teachers?
premises: A triad of powers exists in the Lord.
This triad is another name for his freedom.
The great teachers have made it manifest under names such as will and others.
inference: The teachers revealed the Lord's freedom as a triad of powers, commonly named will and so on.
uncertainties: The verse names only the first member explicitly; the other two are implied by 'icchā-ādi'.
plain_english: Thus the triad of powers in the Lord, which is another name for his freedom, has been made manifest by the great teachers under names such as will and the rest.
